data.name: Cristina
data.long_meaning: Derived from Cristus (Christ) and the Latin suffix -ina, meaning 'Anointed One'. In Christian tradition, Cristina represents devotion, compassion, and loyalty to God.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of divine anointment and grace.

in_hebrew.name: כריסטינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם כריסטינה מקורו ביוונית ומשמעו משיח האל, נגזר מהמילה כריסטוס, המשמשת לתיאור ישו המשיח, והסופיקס -ינה המרמזת על שייכות או השתייכות

in_greek.name: Χριστίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χριστίνα προέρχεται από τη λέξη Χριστός, που αναφέρεται στον Ιησού Χριστό, και το συuffix -ίνα, που υποδηλώνει σχέση ή ιδιοκτησία, οπότε το όνομα Χριστίνα σημαίνει αγγλιστί «αυτή που ανήκει στο Χριστό»

in_latin.name: Christina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christina derivatur a nomine Christus, quod refertur ad Iesum Christum, et suffixo -ina, quod indicat relationem vel proprietatem, itaque nomen Christina significat «ea quae pertinet ad Christum»

in_english.name: Cristina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cristina is derived from the Greek name Christina, meaning follower of Christ, originating from the Greek word Christos, referring to Jesus Christ, and the suffix -ina, indicating relationship or possession

biblical_reference.note: not directly mentioned in the Bible

saint_reference.note: a 3rd-century martyr and saint in the Catholic Church

data.cultural_impact: The name Cristina has been popular in European countries, particularly in Spain and Portugal, since the Middle Ages.
data.spiritual_significance: Cristina represents the anointed one, a title given to Jesus in Christianity, affirming a deep connection to the divine and a commitment to Christian values and beliefs.

historical_references.reference: In Christian tradition, Cristina is associated with Saint Christina of Bolsena, a 4th-century martyr.
historical_references.context: The name Cristina is derived from the Latin name Christina, which is itself derived from the Greek name Christína, meaning 'follower of Christ'.

trends: popularized by the Spanish royal family, particularly Queen Cristina of Sweden
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Cristina remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Cristina in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Cristina, which means "Anointed". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Cristina is derived from the Greek word "Christos," meaning "Anointed One" or "Christ." This name symbolizes the spiritual connection between the bearer and Jesus Christ, emphasizing their dedication to following His teachings and living a Christian life.
